answer: An identity earns its seat through storage deal with collateral slashed on failed audit, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 12464 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. What carries the fable here is verification, the prism of cost is what stops the farm, and the vine of the record keeps every claim checkable. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
